proof_body:
by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
  have h0 : HasSum f (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) := hasSum_zeta_two
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n + 1) := fun a b h => by simpa using h
  have hodd : Summable (fun n : ℕ => f (2 * n + 1)) := h0.summable.comp_injective hinj
  have heven : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => f (2 * n)) (Real.pi ^ 2 / 24) := by
    have e1 : (fun n : ℕ => f (2 * n)) = fun n : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) * f n := by
      funext n; simp only [f]; push_cast; ring
    have e2 : Real.pi ^ 2 / 24 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6) := by ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact h0.mul_left _
  have htot := HasSum.even_add_odd heven hodd.hasSum
  have huniq := htot.unique h0
  have h := hodd.hasSum
  have e : ∑' n : ℕ, f (2 * n + 1) = Real.pi ^ 2 / 8 := by linarith
  rw [e] at h
  have e1 : (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (2 * (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) = fun n : ℕ => f (2 * n + 1) := by
    funext n; simp only [f]; push_cast; ring
  rw [e1]; exact h
